title: In a preliminary ruling, a US judge orders Perplexity to stop using Comet browser to make purchases on behalf of users from password-protected Amazon accounts (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: In a preliminary ruling, a US judge orders Perplexity to stop using Comet browser to make purchases on behalf of users from password-protected Amazon accounts — Perplexity AI Inc. must for now stop using its Comet web browser agent to make purchases on behalf of shoppers …
